parameters.content:
## XML to JSON lab
Synthetic catalog data. No credentials, network calls or external writes.
Run lab → Assert 8 cases should report 8/8. Split products previews 8 products, including 2 review rows.
Before real writes, filter product.status = ready and use your destination’s unique SKU/upsert rules.
Parse settings are explicit. Normalize catalog expects catalog/product, $ attributes and scalar child text.
Author: OperantSolo · https://operantsolo.com/n8n-xml-to-json/
